metadata.source: SEC EDGAR DEF 14A proxy statements, Item 402(v) Pay versus Performance disclosure
metadata.coverage_note: Wave 5 coverage: 49 companies (12-company pilot of 2026-09-19, 10-company wave 2 of 2026-09-20, 10-company wave 3 of 2026-09-20, 10-company wave 4 of 2026-09-20, 7-company wave 5 of 2026-09-21; INTC excluded from wave 5: its 2026 proxy carries no Inline XBRL; MS and LRCX wave-5 filings unavailable on EDGAR Archives). Full S&P 500 rollout pending.
metadata.methodology: Values transcribed from the rendered Pay versus Performance table in each company's latest DEF 14A filing, using per-ticker manual column maps verified against the filing HTML. The four compensation columns were cross-checked against Inline XBRL facts (ecd:PeoTotalCompAmt, PeoActuallyPaidCompAmt, NonPeoNeoAvgTotalCompAmt, NonPeoNeoAvgCompActuallyPaidAmt); all 242 company-years passed with zero rejections. TSR columns show the value of an initial fixed $100 investment. Units vary by filer and are recorded per company; compensation normalized to dollars. Fiscal-year filers (PG, HD, COST, ORCL, WMT, CRM, DIS, CSCO, INTU, PANW, NKE) show the year as filed. JNJ files two peer TSR series (S&P Pharmaceuticals and S&P Healthcare Equipment); AMZN files two peer TSR series (NYSE Technology and S&P Retail). PLTR lists no company-selected measure; its CSM fields are null. NOW files two peer TSR series (2025 peer group and prior peer group); Citi (C) files net income in $B. C (2021), TMUS (2025), NKE (2025-2026) show multiple PEOs with per-executive XBRL member verification. MU (fiscal filer, Aug yr-end), CAT (CEO change May 1 2025, Creed+Umpleby 2025), AMAT (fiscal filer, Oct yr-end; neg. PEO CAP 2022), MRK (net income filed in $000s; Davis+Frazier 2021), PM (Calantzopoulos+Olczak 2021; CSM = currency-neutral adj. diluted EPS growth %), RTX (Calio+Hayes 2024-2025; neg. Hayes CAP 2023), GEV (2 PvP years only, spun off Apr 2024).
metadata.rollout_exclusions: KKR & Co. Inc. (KKR): exempt from Item 402(v) pay-versus-performance disclosure until its Sunset Date per 2026 10-K (acc 0001404912-26-000007); exclude from 402(v) rollout until then. Blackstone Inc. (BX): controlled company, generally not subject to Dodd-Frank say-on-pay/say-on-frequency provisions per 2026 10-K (acc 0001193125-26-082531); treat 402(v) as exempt likewise.
